subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

A vacation is the time to relax and break up from the routine.
solution:
The correct answer is **'break up.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When we look at the sentence, we get to know that the wrong phrase has been used here.
 
• The phrase **'break up'** means **to end the relationship or cause something to separate into several pieces, parts, or sections.**
 
 
• For example, John and Marry have **broken up**.
 
• They **broke up** for the holidays in June.
 
• **Break up** the chocolate and place it in a bowl.
 
 
 
• So, the phrase **'break up'** has to be replaced with **'take a break.'**
 
• **Take a break - **to stop doing something for a short period of time.
 
 
• For Example - I'm tired. Let's **take a break.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

The sentence would be - *A vacation is the time to relax and take a break from the routine.*
